claim: Ensemble: 1 delay line per channel, 2-tap linear interpolation, delay time read from state 0x254/0x264 every sample
Ensemble LFO = triangle |phase| from float accumulator in [-1,1), inc=2f/fs; R phase offset = 0.5*Stereo (max 90 deg)
Ensemble chorus mode: sweep fixed 2.6 ms p-p (sm1=0.0026*fs, 0x3b2a64c3), offset 1.3*Delay; Intensity sets LFO rate f=0.1+2.9*I Hz
Ensemble vibrato mode: delay-time one-pole smoothing k=min(1,1.6223*2pi/fs) (0x3fcfa787); rate pitch 22v-16 -> 3.24..11.56 Hz
Ensemble has no feedback; output L = in + (vol*((1-mix)*e0 + 4.0738*mix*e1) - in)*bypass; mix is linear
SCF: single mono delay (input (L+R)*0.5), 4-tap Lagrange read with taps i-2,i,i+1,i+2 (i-2 in the -1 slot)
SCF LFO = square wave (+1.11 offset) x depth^2*{1.2,2.8,4.5} through two one-pole LPs at min(f_lfo, 3.28|2 Hz)
SCF delay = fs*base*(1+lfo+0.5*p7), base 4.4 ms (mode 0) / 1.39 ms (modes 1,2), clamp 1..0.05*fs
SCF delay write = -2.3*HP472(sm5*0.54*LP + HP141(sm4*sm1*(dry+D))); flanger feedback sm4=0.64*p2 -> loop gain up to -0.898; R = (1-2*p3)*(dry+wet)+2*p3*dry (wet inverted on R at p3=1)
